title: What a failed exit with no further route does (V3 no fallback, unknown dex, paused)

options.name: Keep current behaviour: return false, no failed-held record, no timer re-arm
options.risk: After an anti-rug or dashboard exit the position is held with no routine poll while the alert says it is monitored (AUD-EXIT-007).

options.name: Route every non-closing return through the balance-truth handling (persist exit_failed_held, re-arm, truthful alert)
options.behavior_impact: Every still-held position ends with a poll timer and a persisted state.
options.risk: Counts these as failures toward the routine pause.

options.name: Additionally add a V3 public fallback (exactInputSingle with a bounded floor)
options.behavior_impact: V3 positions get the same guaranteed lever as V2.
options.risk: New code on the money path; needs its own fork proof.

recommendation: uniform-failed-held now, and decide v3-public-fallback with OD-39.
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract). This card covers S1 capital findings, which cannot rest on the default: until it is decided and fixed it blocks the live re-entry gate.
behavior_impact: Decides whether any exit failure can leave a position unmonitored.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion (capital fixes, after the Phase 23 real-path proof)
